## Spec delta / Spec skip reason

**Spec skip reason:** This repo has no root `spec.md`. `Plans.md` is generated by mechanically restructuring the existing, already-authoritative root `TODO.md` into the task-ledger format — no new product, API, data-model, permission, billing, or distribution decisions are introduced beyond what `TODO.md`, `README.md`, and the per-crate `README.md`/`TODO.md` files already commit to. If a task below later needs a product-behavior decision that isn't already fixed in those documents (e.g. the exact `hl7-arrow` Arrow schema shape in HT-T10.1), a `spec.md` should be created at that point — noted inline on the task.

## v0.1 Scope — `hl7-arrow` crate

> **Goal:** ship a sibling crate that emits parsed HL7 v2 messages as Apache Arrow RecordBatches, so Rust-based HL7 ingestion can feed any Arrow-capable downstream (Python, TypeScript, R, Julia) without custom FFI or subprocess JSON round-tripping.
> **License impact:** none — `arrow-rs` is Apache-2.0, compatible with `deny.toml`'s allow-list; confirm transitive deps under HT-T10.3.
> **SemVer impact:** new sibling crate at its own `0.1.0`; no breaking changes to `hl7-mllp`, `hl7-v2`, `hl7-mindray`, `fhir-r4`, `satusehat` — `hl7-arrow` only consumes `hl7-v2` read-only.
> **Architectural posture:** one job, no runtime/transport opinion — emits RecordBatches, consumers choose the transport (stdout, file, socket, Flight, shared memory).

| Task | Description | DoD | Depends | Status |

| HT-T10.1 | Design Arrow schema for HL7 v2 messages [tdd:skip:schema-design-precedes-code] | `crates/hl7-arrow/README.md` published with schema-version matrix; RecordBatch schema defined for at least ORU^R01, covering type fidelity (TS/NM → Timestamp/Float64/Utf8), nullability/repetition (`List<T>`), segment grouping (struct/list columns), schema-version metadata field, and neutral HL7 field naming | HT-T01 | cc:done |

## Toolchain reference

| Tool | Purpose | Install |
|---|---|---|
| `cargo-audit` | CVE scanning | `cargo install cargo-audit` |
| `cargo-deny` | License + advisory policy | `cargo install cargo-deny` |
| `cargo-tarpaulin` | Coverage (Linux only) | `cargo install cargo-tarpaulin` |
| `cargo-semver-checks` | Breaking-change detection | `cargo install cargo-semver-checks` |
| `cargo-release` | Automated release workflow | `cargo install cargo-release` |
| `cargo-fuzz` | Fuzz testing (requires nightly) | `cargo install cargo-fuzz` |
| `cargo-machete` | Unused dependency detection | `cargo install cargo-machete` |
| `cargo-skill` *(v0.1)* | Skill discovery/packaging for Cargo projects | `cargo install cargo-skill` |

Wiring READMEs into rustdoc turned every fenced code block into a real doctest, which surfaced three new error classes across the workspace: a bare ` ``` ` fence parsed as Rust instead of text (hl7-mllp's MLLP frame diagram), a mistaken assumption that rustdoc auto-wraps `?` into a Result-returning `fn main` (it does not — fixed by replacing top-level `?` with `.unwrap()` in every README doctest), and a genuine lifetime-escaping bug pattern when `hl7-v2`'s `Field::component`/`Field::value` (both elide their return lifetime to `&self`) are called inside a closure that takes an owned `Field<'_>` by value (fixed by converting to owned `String` inside the closure rather than switching to `raw_fields()`, preserving the illustrative example). Also fixed stale content the `include_str!` swap would otherwise have shipped as-is: `hl7-arrow/README.md`'s claim that "no code exists yet" (false since HT-T10–HT-T10.3 landed), and stale `Status` version claims in `hl7-v2/README.md` (`0.0.1`) and `hl7-mllp/README.md` (`0.1.0` vs actual `0.2.0`). Finally, fixed a `rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links` false-positive on all 5 badge-block READMEs (`hl7-v2`, `hl7-mllp`, `hl7-mindray`, `fhir-r4`, `satusehat`): rustdoc's markdown-link parser treats a bare `](LICENSE)` target (no `/`, no extension, no URL scheme) as an intra-doc-link candidate and warns when it can't resolve — fixed by qualifying as `](./LICENSE)`. Verified: `cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --all-features` zero warnings beyond the pre-existing, unrelated `workspace.edition`/`workspace.rust-version` manifest-key warnings; `cargo test --workspace --all-features` passes (72 passed, 5 ignored, 13 suites) including all new README doctests; `cargo build`/`clippy --all-targets --all-features -D warnings`/`fmt --all --check` all clean; confirmed zero `missing_docs` warnings anywhere (all 6 crates keep `#![warn(missing_docs)]`). |
